input.prompt:
A cinematic animated-film still, medium-wide view across a wooden drawing desk toward a young woman absorbed in her sketchbook. Chestnut-brown hair in a loose low ponytail, a few soft strands around her face, expressive brown eyes, plain loose violet long-sleeved shirt. Her right hand holds a yellow graphite pencil naturally against the page; her left hand rests lightly on the paper. Calm, thoughtful expression, eyes looking down. The open spiral-bound sketchbook contains a recognizable pencil drawing of a white unicorn in side profile facing right.

Late-afternoon sunlight enters through a tall window on the left, illuminating her cheek, hair edges, hands and the paper. A black adjustable desk lamp, ceramic mug, jars of pencils, a few worn books and small trailing plants sit around the desk. Behind her are pinned sketches, shelves and a softly rumpled bed. Layered depth and lovingly observed everyday detail, without obscuring the girl or the drawing. Clear hand-drawn character contours and restrained cel shading against a richly painted room, textured wood, luminous amber light and soft green foliage; warm shadows retain their color. The image feels intimate and believable, not plastic or glossy. One girl, two anatomically coherent hands, one pencil, no additional people.

Landscape 16:9, one full-frame image, no text, logos, panels or borders.

input.prompt: Refine this image into a richer cinematic animation frame while preserving this young woman's recognizable face, chestnut ponytail and plain violet shirt. The room should be lush, sun-drenched and deeply layered: trailing ivy around the window, leafy potted plants and flowers catching sunlight, richly textured wood, scattered art supplies, pinned small colorful drawings, books, a soft teal blanket on the bed. Strong low golden sunlight streams in diagonally, bright amber pools on the desk and beautiful luminous rim lighting on hair and sleeves, green foliage and cool teal shadows balancing the warmth. Preserve simple elegant hand-drawn character contours and expressive face, but render the ENVIRONMENT as a much more detailed painterly film background with atmospheric depth and subtle soft foreground blur; avoid uniformly thick dark outlines or flat brown walls. Her right hand makes a pencil mark and her left hand rests naturally beside it.
